thread.title: New Online Tool Will Aid Police Making Requests for Data From Apple -Reuters

author: morningstar.com
title: New Online Tool Will Aid Police Making Requests for Data From Apple -Reuters
text:
By Stephen Nakrosis
--Apple Inc. (AAPL) is planning to create an online tool that would allow law enforcement to formally request data about the company's users, Reuters reported Thursday, citing "a company letter seen by Reuters."
--Apple also is planning to put together a team that would teach police what data can be obtained from Apple, the report said.
--Apple General Counsel Kate Adams sent the letter, dated Sept. 4, to Democratic Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse of Rhode Island, the report said.
Full story: https://www.reuters.com/article/us-apple-data/apple-to-provide-online-tool-for-police-to-request-data-letter-idUSKCN1LM39O
